name: LFV (Luftfartsverket)
notes: lfv.se (Press): 'LFV är ett statligt affärsverk som leder flygtrafiken genom det övre luftrummet' and provides air traffic services at Swedavia and military airfields; LFV owns no airports. The logo is the 300x140 PNG in the site header ('LFVs logotyp', tier 2, website-served; orange on transparent). The press page points to press releases and pictures in a third-party press room (Via-TT), which is not an official domain and was not used. No brand page or logo terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.
